0.0: Now listen, #b#h0##k. I know you were famous on Victoria Island, but El Nath requires a whole new level of talent. Work hard and play your cards right, and you'll get your sponsor.\r\n#L0##bA sponsor? What do I need a sponsor for?#l\n#k
0.1: Hey, the Silent Crusade isn't cheap to run. Even the big monsters don't drop that many mesos.\r\nSo, we get funding from outside sources. Are you interested in the details?

yes.0: If you distinguish yourself within the Silent Crusade, you will get a sponsor. These are wealthy, powerful citizens of Maple World who believe in our cause. Most of our operating funds come from sponsors.
yes.1: If you want to get a sponsor, get to level #b43#k.

no.0: Sometimes you have to rely on others, #b#h0##k. You can't do everything yourself.

1.0: You're here! I heard you already made level 43. Not bad, but that won't impress me. Keep it up, if you can. Hey, what's wrong? You look confused...
1.1: You don't need to worry, #b#h0##k. I'm sure you'll find one.

yes.0: Look, I'm sorry I laughed at you. Seriously. *Snicker*
